description: This Kotlin source file defines the CategoryRepository class, which acts as a data repository for fetching categories of content from an API service. It provides suspend functions to obtain lists of content items for different categories, handling errors gracefully by returning empty lists. The class interacts with an API interface and transforms DTOs into ContentItem objects.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages fetching categorized content data from an API, handling network calls and errors.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches a list of content items for the specified HomeCategory, returning a Result containing the list or an empty list upon failure.
